cover_headline: Priyansh Arya Smashes 181 Off 68 Balls, the Second-Highest Score in T20 History

end.headline: Priyansh Arya Smashes 181 Off 68 Balls, the Second-Highest Score in T20 History
end.line: The Delhi captain's 19 sixes equalled the world record for a T20 innings as Delhi posted 275 for 5 and beat Tamil Nadu by 116 runs in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy in Indore.

facts: Priyansh Arya scored 181 off 68 balls — the highest T20 score by an Indian and the second-highest in men's T20 history
His 19 sixes equalled Finn Allen's world record for a T20 innings; his fifty took 18 balls and his century 36
Delhi posted 275 for 5 and won by 116 runs as Tamil Nadu were bowled out for 159
